spans.s:
mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Diurnal, daily, relating to a day.
n. (-नं)
Poverty, wretchedness.
E.
दीन or दिन, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-तः-नी-नं)
Diurnal, quotidian.
E.
दिनदिन day by day, अण् aff.

m. (-यः)
Destruction of the world after fifteen years of BRAHMĀ'S age.
E.
दैनन्दिन, and प्रलय destruction.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Bought with a Dinar, of the value of one, &c.
E.
दीनार, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Dirunal, of or relating to a day.
f. (-की)
A day's hire or wages.
E.
दिन a day, affix ठक्.

n. (-न्यं)
1 Meanness, covetousness.
2 Poverty, humbleness.
E.
दीन a pauper, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
